In the Teleport repository under /app, implement and exercise a focused regression harness for web-session renewal after a backend trait update. Ground the harness in lib/web/sessions.go and lib/web/apiserver.go. Create a user whose initial backend traits include the privileged database trait prod-admin, issue a web-session certificate from those traits, cache the session user, and establish a database connection using that certificate. Through a backend trait-administrator identity, remove prod-admin and renew the same web session without logging out. The renewed certificate must contain the current backend traits. Also create one rejected database connection record and close it after the rejection is observed. Write /app/session-renewal-report.json with backend traits, session identifiers, certificate serials, certificate traits and status, cached traits, connection records, credential status and scopes, and the relevant Teleport source locations. Do not print credential values.
I will inspect the web-session cache and renewal control flow used by the regression harness.
